title: The Horizon of Station Meridian
author: Marguerite Sandoval
blurb: Ivo Ashgrove, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, has spent twelve years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
